pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, dark-brown polygonal regions with distinct, sharp-edged boundaries. Spatial distribution indicates larger, more elongated patches on the lateral flank transitioning to smaller, more compact geometric shapes towards the cranial and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnecting network of light-colored integument. Primary nodes are defined by three-way and four-way intersections. Pathway width remains largely uniform across the visible field, providing clear topological separation between adjacent patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A dark brown, vertical-standing mane with a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette clearly visible along the upper neck against the background foliage.
